Jordan Rivera
jordan.rivera@example.com · +1 415 555 0142 · Oakland, CA, USA

Dear Acme Ledger Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Lead Software Engineer, Frontend (React) role at Acme Ledger. My experience combines hands-on frontend delivery with technical leadership in fintech. At Brightline Payments, I am a Senior Software Engineer and tech lead for a squad of 5 engineers, with responsibility for the frontend platform roadmap, design reviews, and code reviews. My background includes nine years building web platforms and frontend architecture for a payments product used by 2 million customers.

I led the merchant dashboard migration from Angular to React and TypeScript, cutting p95 page load from 4.1s to 1.6s and reducing frontend incidents by 60% over the following year. To strengthen checkout releases, I built a Playwright end-to-end suite with 220 scenarios and integrated it with GitHub Actions, moving from manual QA to a 25-minute automated gate. Alongside delivery, I mentored 4 engineers, two of whom were promoted to senior, and introduced a weekly architecture review that cut rework on large features by about a third.

Acme Ledger's frontend rebuild and hands-on lead role align with the work I have done on the merchant dashboard and checkout SDK. I designed and shipped the React checkout SDK adopted by 1,200 merchants in its first six months, processing $410M annually. My current stack also includes Next.js, GraphQL, and AWS. Beyond my employment, I maintain react-form-kit, an open-source project providing accessible form primitives for React and used by 3 companies in production. These experiences offer concrete starting points for a conversation about your platform.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome a discussion of how my frontend architecture, performance, and mentoring experience could contribute to Acme Ledger's team.

Sincerely,
Jordan Rivera

# Jordan Rivera
Oakland, CA, USA · jordan.rivera@example.com · +1 415 555 0142 · https://github.com/jrivera-dev · https://linkedin.com/in/jordan-rivera

## Summary
Senior software engineer with nine years building web platforms, including frontend architecture for a payments product used by 2 million customers. Tech lead for a squad of 5 engineers, with React and TypeScript delivery, performance optimization, and mentoring experience.

## Skills
- **Frontend:** React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Next.js
- **Leadership:** Technical Leadership, Mentoring, System Design
- **Quality and delivery:** Performance Optimization, Playwright, CI/CD
- **APIs and cloud:** GraphQL, Node.js, AWS

## Experience
### Senior Software Engineer — Brightline Payments
San Francisco, CA (remote) · Mar 2022 – Present
Tech lead for a squad of 5 engineers since 2024 in fintech; own the frontend platform roadmap and run design reviews and code reviews. Stack includes Next.js, GraphQL, and AWS.
- Led the merchant dashboard migration from Angular to React and TypeScript, cutting p95 page load from 4.1s to 1.6s.
- Reduced frontend incidents by 60% over the year following the dashboard migration.
- Mentored 4 engineers, two promoted to senior, and introduced a weekly architecture review that cut rework on large features by about a third.
- Built Playwright end-to-end testing for checkout with 220 scenarios and integrated GitHub Actions, replacing manual QA with a 25-minute automated gate.
- Designed and shipped a React checkout SDK, 38 KB gzipped, adopted by 1,200 merchants in its first six months and processing $410M annually.

### Software Engineer — Northwind Health
Seattle, WA · Jun 2017 – Feb 2022
Owned the appointment API and its React front end for the patient scheduling product, using JavaScript and Node.js.
- Moved scheduling services to Docker and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines, cutting the build-and-deploy cycle from 2 hours to 20 minutes.
- Rebuilt appointment search with PostgreSQL and Redis caching, reducing median response time from 900ms to 120ms for 3 million monthly searches.

## Projects
- **react-form-kit — maintainer:** Open-source accessible form primitives using React and TypeScript; 1.9k GitHub stars and production use at 3 companies. Accessibility experience through this project.

## Education
- B.S. in Computer Science, University of Washington, 2017

## Certifications
- AWS Certified Developer – Associate, Amazon Web Services, 2023 (valid through May 2029)
